description: BI-FEDD8F45: guard owner, purpose and expected catch class, keyed by namespaced guard id (loop:<file stem>, policy:<id>, hook:<name>). An undeclared guard gets a derived default and is listed as undeclared on /ops/gate-efficacy; no gate refuses an undeclared guard. baselineInputs names the files whose change counts as raising the guard's baseline. keep {owner, expiry YYYY-MM-DD, reason, decisionRef} silences the retirement review until its expiry.

hook:pre-push-gate.purpose: Refuse a push that has no passing local-CI gate record for its branch and sha.

policy:repo-guard-loop.purpose: Run every check-no-* guard; its own results are recorded per guard as loop:*.

loop:check-no-unrouted-owner-escalation.purpose: Refuse an owner-attention write (needs-human self-fix class, a build-stall-escalation report, an escalation notice) outside the routeToHuman seam, so every hand-off to the owner passes the escalation gate (BI-5E067004).
